lines.en: I hang from a leaf, still.
My shell cannot walk.
A breeze comes and I sway.
Silk holds me to the leaf's underside.
I do not shift half an inch a day.
I am changing inside.
My casing turns from green to brown.
I rock with the leaf.
I cannot even sneeze.
My joints are not formed yet.

lines.zh: 这片叶子就是我的全部
lines.en: This leaf is my whole world.
Rain beats me downward.
I cinch myself tighter with silk.
I have no need to walk.

lines.zh: 我挂在离地三格的地方
lines.en: I hang three blocks above the ground.
I am waiting for one day.
I sit as still as a fruit.
It is dark and cramped inside.

lines.zh: 我能感到自己的形状在变
lines.en: I feel my shape changing.
Sounds outside are muffled.
I wait, day after day.

lines.zh: 我的旧皮正在底下化开
lines.en: My old skin is dissolving underneath.
I can only hang where I am.
I am a small room.
Sunlight reaches me through the leaf.
I know time is passing.
You cannot see me inside.
Coming closer will not help.
I can feel your shadow.
Do not pull me; I would break.

lines.zh: 我在叶背上，不容易发现
lines.en: I am on the leaf's back, hard to spot.
You would have to wait a long while.
Your breath moves me.

lines.zh: 平原上的茧，听得见脚步。
lines.en: From my cocoon, I hear your steps.
You come to check on me every day.
I cannot cry; it is muffled in here.
You hurt what is inside.
The silk loosened a little.
Please do not touch me again.
My shell is seeping.
A hairline crack, and it stings.
Do not knock; I am not finished in here.

lines.zh: 我缩紧身体，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: I squeeze tight and pass for a leaf.
I do not feed; I only wait.
I cannot bite that leaf.
Putting it closer will not help.

lines.zh: 我里面只有化开的旧皮
lines.en: Inside is only my old skin, dissolving.
What you hold is a flower, not mine.
Right now I need only quiet.
I do not know that smell.
Do not come over and touch me.
Your touch set me swaying.
The silk nearly snapped.
My shell has a little give.
Please do not come any nearer.
You hit the leaf.
I managed to steady myself.
That startled me.
I have no feet to step back.
The leaf stem is creaking.
Please be gentle with me.
I am still only a pupa.
That must wait until I emerge.
There is only me in here.
I have no mouth to answer.
Wait for the adult stage.
Nothing can be discussed now.
I am sealed inside.
Such thoughts do not reach in here.
Just wait quietly.
I should sleep for a while.
I do not even have feet.
Things fall below the leaf.
I cannot even turn.
All I can do is fall.
You pick it up, then.
I saw it; I cannot help.
The silk is pinned by that thing.
Do not move me for that.
It is over by the roots.
Go over there yourself.
I cannot lock onto anything.
I cannot see you at all.

lines.zh: 我只知道有东西在附近
lines.en: I only know something is near.
Do not stand here too long.
I must stay a while longer.
Wait for this wind to stop.
You wait; so do I.
Do not let anyone touch me.
I will remember this quiet.
I feel a shadow pass.
The leaf is yellowing.
My shell has hardened.
It grows crowded inside.
I hear wings.
It will be soon now.
I have shed my old skin.

lines.zh: 你再来的时候，也许不同
lines.en: Next time you come, it may be different.
Do not go too far away.
I cannot hurt anyone.
All I can do is drop.
Your foot struck the trunk.
I could put no force into it.
My shell is hard; it might jab you.
Do not put your face this close.
I am only a pupa.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，只能用壳顶你。
lines.en: Hanging under the leaf, all I can do is butt you with my shell.
I was laid on this leaf.
I have only just finished this casing.
A thread hangs me here.
This plain is my home.
I came from a caterpillar.
I hang under the leaf, hard to see.
You must look up to find me.
I am waiting to emerge.
I will never move from here.
Fire curled the leaf.
I fell; my shell dented.
Water got inside my shell.
An arrow pierced my shell.

lines.zh: 法术打乱了我变化的速度
lines.en: Magic disordered my change.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但要耗尽自己
lines.en: I do not eat; I am spending myself.
Thunder shook the stem.
